data.label: Backend Programming Languages
data.description: Choose a core backend language: Node.js (TypeScript), Python (FastAPI/Django), Go, or Java (Spring Boot). Learn asynchronous concurrency, garbage collection, and memory management.

data.label: Relational Databases (PostgreSQL / MySQL)
data.description: Master SQL querying, ACID transactions, relational schema normalization, B-Tree indexes, joins, foreign keys, and connection pooling.

data.label: NoSQL Databases (MongoDB / DynamoDB)
data.description: Document and key-value stores for unstructured or high-scale data. Understand eventual consistency, sharding, and aggregation pipelines.

data.label: RESTful APIs & GraphQL
data.description: Design clean, scalable APIs. Understand HTTP status codes, CORS, idempotency, OpenAPI specifications, rate limiting, and GraphQL schemas.
data.codeSnippet:
/* OpenAPI / Swagger REST Schema Definition */
/api/v1/users/{id}:
  get:
    summary: Fetch User Details
    parameters:
      - name: id
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string }

data.label: Authentication & Authorization (JWT, OAuth2)
data.description: Secure API routes with JWT tokens, HTTP-only cookies, OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, password hashing (Argon2 / bcrypt), and RBAC.

data.label: Caching & Memory Stores (Redis / Memcached)
data.description: In-memory caching strategies (Write-Through, Cache-Aside), TTL expiration, rate-limiting counters, and session storage with Redis.

data.label: System Design & Microservices (Kafka / RabbitMQ)
data.description: Event-driven architecture, message queues (RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka), distributed tracing, gRPC inter-service RPCs, and saga transactions.
